stem.text: The diagram shows a bond between two molecules transported in a xylem vessel.

stem.alt: Drawing of two water molecules, each with a labelled oxygen and two hydrogen atoms, with partial charges printed, and a dashed bond labelled bond R between a hydrogen of one molecule and the oxygen of the other.

stem.text: Which row correctly names bond R and states the role of the bond between these molecules for their transport in a xylem vessel?

A.text: hydrogen; adhesion of the molecules to the wall of the xylem vessel

B.text: hydrogen; cohesion of the molecules in the lumen of the xylem vessel

C.text: ionic; adhesion of the molecules to the wall of the xylem vessel

D.text: ionic; cohesion of the molecules in the lumen of the xylem vessel
